user_story: As a user, I want to start and stop the progress bar so that I can see the progress of an operation. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Start', the progress bar should start progressing. 2. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Stop', the progress should stop. 3. The URL should remain the same: 'https://demoqa.com/progress-bar'.
